# Nandhu S. Mahendran

> Nandhu S. Mahendran is an Indian entrepreneur from Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu. He is the Founder & CEO of four companies: Blunar Co (parent company), Zeshin (software & AI), Med Blunar (medtech) and HodoMate (tourismtech). He is also an Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) student at Syed Ammal Engineering College, Ramanathapuram.

Official website: https://nandhusmahendran.zeshin.in/
Also known as: Nandhu, Nandhu S M, Nandhu Mahendran

## Companies
- Blunar Co (https://blunar.co.in): parent company. A technology startup building software, apps, AI tools, digital devices and environmental-impact technology, with a digital marketing studio for businesses across Tamil Nadu. Role: Founder & CEO.
- Zeshin (https://zeshin.in): a Blunar Co company. Software and AI: SaaS products, custom business software, business websites and AI automation. Tagline: "Beyond the build". Role: Founder & CEO.
- Med Blunar: medtech startup building medical devices and health technology. Role: Founder & CEO.
- HodoMate: tourismtech startup building technology for travellers and tourism businesses. Role: Founder & CEO.

## Products and builds
- FOSIC (Zeshin): campus canteen food ordering; pilot live at one college.
- SchoolKnot (Zeshin, https://schoolknot.zeshin.in): Tamil-first parent–teacher app with voice notes.
- Abacus Centre Manager (Zeshin, https://ucmas-seven.vercel.app): management system for abacus training centres.
- ViMatt (Med Blunar): first Med Blunar product; prototype completed, in development.
- SpineEase Vest (Med Blunar): therapeutic haptic vest prototype with eight motors along the spine (ESP32-S3).
- HealthCom: connected healthcare platform (in development).
- VOLTRA 26 website (https://voltrasaec.online): national-level technical symposium of the ECE & BME departments, Syed Ammal Engineering College; Nandhu was an Executive Member.

## Track record
- Built web products and software for 15+ companies.
- Ran digital marketing for 20+ businesses (Tamil / Tanglish content, Meta ads, WhatsApp funnels, local SEO).
- Competed in technical events at 30+ colleges across Tamil Nadu and won 40+ events.
- 1st Place, Dakshaa national-level techno-cultural fest.
- 4th Prize and Investment Cohort selection, Dindigul Science & Technology Fest (Kaar Tech and Startup TN).
- Presented at MSME Idea Hackathon 2026 (filtration round, Solamalai Foundation for Startup Incubation).
